title: Ambient Sound & Audio Volumes 🌍
description: Place spatialised audio, create reverb zones, and manage sound classes.

slides.title: Ambient Sound Actor 🌳
slides.content:
# Place Sounds in the World

An **Ambient Sound** actor plays a Sound Cue at a location:

* From Place Actors → Audio → **Ambient Sound**, drag into the level.
* Assign a Sound Cue in Details.
* Enable **Auto Activate** to start on level load.
* Set **Attenuation** settings directly or via a shared asset.

Use for wind, water, machinery, and background noise. Multiple Ambient Sounds create a rich soundscape.

quizData.question: An Ambient Sound actor can only play 2D stereo sounds.
quizData.explanation: It supports 3D spatialisation and attenuation, making it perfect for world‑placed audio.

slides.title: Audio Volumes 📦
slides.content:
# Zone‑Based Audio

An **Audio Volume** changes the audio environment inside a region:

* Place a volume (Place Actors → Volumes → **Audio Volume**).
* In Details, assign a **Reverb Settings** asset (or create one).
* Also set **Interior/Exterior** settings for ambient zone effects.
* When the listener enters the volume, the reverb or filter activates.

Use for: cave echo, underwater muffling, large hall reverb.

slides.title: Sound Classes & Mixes 🎛️
slides.content:
## Organise and Control

A **Sound Class** groups sounds for volume control and effects:

* Create a Sound Class (Content Browser → Sounds → Sound Class).
* In a Sound Cue or Sound Wave, set the **Sound Class** property.
* Organise classes hierarchically: `Master → SFX, Music, Voice`.
* Then create a **Sound Mix** to adjust volume, EQ, and ducking per class (e.g., duck SFX when dialogue plays).

This gives you global mix control without touching individual cues.

quizData.question: To lower the volume of all music when a character speaks, you would use a _____ Mix.
quizData.explanation: Sound Mixes adjust properties of Sound Classes globally, enabling ducking.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use Convolution Reverb

For hyper‑realistic spaces, use a **Convolution Reverb** asset with an impulse response recorded in a real location.
